item.title: A National Level SENSATHON’23
item.description: Department of ECE has planned to conduct a National Level SENSATHON’23 on 19th and 20th April 2023. The themes of Hackathon includes Agriculture, Wearable Technology, Health Care, Automotive, Women’s Safety and Assisting System for Physically Disabled. The event has 5 stages namely – Kicker, Milestone-1, Milestone-2, Milestone-3 and Landing. Last date for abstract submission: 25.03.2023

item.title: Top Ranking in NPTEL Exams
item.description: SONA COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY has secured a FIRST POSITION in the FACULTY PERFORMANCE rating given by NPTEL among the 5130 NPTEL Local Chapters in all over India during July-Dec 2022 examinations. SONA is proud to announce that it is the FIRST COLLEGE to bag the FIRST POSITION in faculty performance rating for the 3rd time.

item.title: Sona students won runner-up in the Student Hackathon on AI and ML hosted by IITM Research Park
item.description: IITM Research Park has organized Student Hackathon on AI and ML consisting of 2 Rounds in Total.In the first round a video where balls can be seen pitching in different quadrants is sent as a Problem Statement, where we have to find out how many times the ball had been pitched, and in which quadrant, frame if the video when it exactly pitched.
